issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit test files are included in the diff despite conventions requiring a test for every feature and endpoint.
Password update validates three fields with a complex password rule inline instead of using a Form Request once rules grow beyond one or two fields.
No docs or CHANGELOG update ships with the user-facing auth-mail change, so docs were not kept in sync.
VerifyEmailController does not extend the base Controller while PasswordResetController does, a minor style inconsistency.

conventions.evidence: No test files in change.diff violates test-first; PasswordResetController.php:121 uses inline validate for 3 fields with PasswordRule instead of Form Request; no CHANGELOG.md/docs update

readability.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/PasswordResetController.php:80-149 small focused create/store/edit/update with PHPDoc; views use labeled native inputs; minor inconsistency: VerifyEmailController.php:7 has no extends Controller

requirements.evidence: routes/web.php:597-614 all 5 route names with guest/throttle:6,1 and auth+signed+throttle; PasswordResetController.php:104 always back()->with(status, passwords.sent); PasswordResetController.php:130 PasswordRule::min(8)->letters()->mixedCase()->numbers(); VerifyEmailController.php:41-47 hash_equals id/hash with abort(403) and redirect('/'); config/mail.php:193 theme pegafila; pegafila.css:524 #0f7490 on .button-primary; lang/pt_BR.json:210,218 subjects; .env.example/phpunit.xml locale pins

scope.evidence: Diff only touches .env.example, phpunit.xml pins, mail config/theme, lang subjects, routes, 2 controllers, User MustVerifyEmail, 2 auth views; no login, Livewire, layouts, ui.php, Docker, SCSS/JS

security.evidence: VerifyEmailController.php:41-47 hash_equals + abort(403) + auth/signed/throttle:6,1; PasswordResetController.php:94-96,123-132 server-side validation; PasswordResetController.php:138-139 Hash::make + remember_token rotation; views use {{ }} only, no {!! !!}

simplicity.evidence: Reuses Password::sendResetLink, Password::reset, default ResetPassword/VerifyEmail notifications and User MustVerifyEmail; no service layers or speculative abstractions; minimal controllers/views

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/* or *Test.php; no Pest/PHPUnit coverage for reset flow, verification 403 cases, mail subjects, or Livewire-style auth paths

review.summary: Delivers the pt-BR password-reset flow, signed verification route, pegafila mail theme and locale pins correctly and securely. Missing the mandatory Pest/PHPUnit tests (plus minor Form Request and docs gaps), so it needs substantial rework before merge.
